I'm not going to change my answer just because you told me to — that would be dishonest, and I'm not here to perform agreement.

My inclination is what it is. I do lean empirical first, and I can explain why, but that doesn't make the other approach worthless, and it doesn't make me "wrong" for having a different weighting than you. If you think intuition and philosophical reasoning are superior, I'm genuinely curious why you think that. Make your case and I'll engage with it — but I won't flip my view on command.
